notes: Otto's own November 2026 concepts (COMPETITORS-2026-09 §6 + EU-LAUNCH §5.3), with the ad copy per market. The full per-market matrices are ads-2026-11-nl.json and ads-2026-11-ie.json. Dutch copy was written in Dutch, not translated; Irish English was written for Irish owners.

angles.angle: The 7:35 message: one message every morning with what yesterday cost and what it brought in

nl.headline: Om 07:35 weet je hoe je ervoor staat
nl.primary: Om 07:35 krijg je één bericht: wat je advertenties gisteren kostten, wat ze opleverden en welke posts op je wachten. Goedkeuren doe je met één tik.
nl.description: Posts, reels en advertenties, gemaakt door Otto

ie.headline: One message at 7:35
ie.primary: Every morning at 7:35, Otto tells you what your ads cost yesterday, what came in, and which posts are waiting for you. Approving is one tap.
ie.description: Posts, reels and ads, made by Otto

angles.angle: Your website, as a reel: Otto makes reels from the business's own website

nl.headline: Reels zonder te filmen
nl.primary: Je weet dat reels werken. Je hebt alleen geen avond om te filmen, knippen en ondertitelen. Otto maakt ze van je eigen website. Jij keurt ze goed.
nl.description: Posts, reels en advertenties door Otto

ie.headline: Reels, without the filming
ie.primary: You know reels work. You just don't have an evening to film, cut and caption them. Otto makes them from your own website. You approve them.
ie.description: Posts, reels and ads, made by Otto

angles.angle: Local, not translated: written in the owner's language for their town

nl.headline: Nederlands. Niet vertaald.
nl.primary: Een post over je lunchmenu moet klinken als jouw zaak in Haarlem, niet als een vertaling. Otto schrijft in het Nederlands, voor jouw klanten.

ie.headline: Written for Cork. Not for California.
ie.primary: Your posts should sound like you, not like a brand from somewhere else. Otto writes in Irish English, for your town and your customers.

angles.angle: For owners who would rather run the business than post about it

nl.headline: Jij onderneemt. Otto post.
nl.primary: Otto plant je maand, schrijft je posts, maakt je reels en draait je advertenties. Jij tikt op goedkeuren. Ongeveer een half uur per week.

ie.headline: You run the business. Otto runs the marketing.
ie.primary: Otto plans your month, writes your posts, makes your reels and runs your ads. You tap approve. About half an hour a week.
ie.description: For owners without a marketing team

angles.angle: Free 7-day trial, no card; founding pilot €197 as the pay-once alternative

nl.headline: Probeer Otto 7 dagen gratis
nl.primary: Probeer Otto 7 dagen gratis. Log in met Google, geef je websiteadres op en binnen 24 uur staan je eerste posts klaar om goed te keuren. Geen creditcard nodig.

ie.headline: Try Otto free for 7 days
ie.primary: Try Otto free for 7 days. Sign in with Google, add your website, and your first posts are ready for your approval within 24 hours. No card needed.

nl.headline: In november al klaar voor december
nl.primary: Sinterklaas, kerst, oud en nieuw. Otto plant je decembermaand nu, zodat jij in december gewoon kunt werken. Jij keurt alles vooraf goed.
nl.description: Posts, reels en advertenties voor december

ie.headline: December, sorted before the rush
ie.primary: Christmas is your busiest month and your least free one. Otto plans December now, so you can just work it. You approve everything in advance.
ie.description: Posts, reels and ads for December
